rules.statement: A person having the right of pre-emption is entitled to exercise the right by offering to buy the land at the price actually paid for it by a purchaser, and not at the market value.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under the Thesawalamai a person having the right of pre-emption of a land is entitled to exercise the right by offering to buy the land at the price-actually paid for it by a purchaser. In such a case he is not entitled to assert the right by offering to buy the land at the market value."
